STATUS: CONFLICT
The clinic protocol note states that an SNP is hard-filtered when FS > 45 [fx_clinic_fs]. The knowledge graph gives the SNP threshold of procedure HF-01 as FS > 60.0 [G:Threshold:FS_gt_60_snp] [G:Procedure:HF-01]. The two values differ, and the sources do not state which one applies.
